SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value > 80;

votes.sql:
SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha1 ON s.id = ha1.hero_id
JOIN attribute a1 ON ha1.attribute_id = a1.id
AND a1.attribute_name = 'Strength'
JOIN hero_attribute ha2 ON s.id = ha2.hero_id
JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
AND a2.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name
ORDER BY (ha1.attribute_value + ha2.attribute_value) DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH hero_scores AS (
    SELECT s.id AS hero_id,
           s.superhero_name,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.attribute_name = 'Strength' THEN ha.attribute_value END),0) +
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence' THEN ha.attribute_value END),0) AS combined_score
    FROM superhero s
    LEFT JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
    GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT hs.hero_id, hs.superhero_name, hs.combined_score
    FROM hero_scores hs
    JOIN (
        SELECT m.superhero_id
        FROM movie m
        WHERE m.release_year > 2015
        GROUP BY m.superhero_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
    ) mv ON mv.superhero_id = hs.hero_id
),
top3 AS (
    SELECT superhero_name, hero_id, combined_score
    FROM qualified
    ORDER BY combined_score DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT t.superhero_name,
       m.title,
       m.release_year
FROM top3 t
JOIN movie m ON m.superhero_id = t.hero_id
WHERE m.release_year > 2015
ORDER BY t.combined_score DESC, m.release_year;

votes.sql:
SELECT p.publisher_name,
       a.alignment,
       AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS avg_strength
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute attr ON ha.attribute_id = attr.id AND attr.attribute_name = 'Strength'
JOIN hero_power hp1 ON hp1.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp1 ON hp1.power_id = sp1.id AND sp1.power_name = 'Lantern Power Ring'
JOIN hero_power hp2 ON hp2.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp2 ON hp2.power_id = sp2.id AND sp2.power_name = 'Accelerated Healing'
WHERE s.debut_year > 2000
GROUP BY p.publisher_name, a.alignment;

SELECT
    p.publisher_name,
    a.alignment,
    AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS avg_strength_score
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute attr ON ha.attribute_id = attr.id
JOIN hero_power hp1 ON s.id = hp1.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp1 ON hp1.power_id = sp1.id
JOIN hero_power hp2 ON s.id = hp2.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp2 ON hp2.power_id = sp2.id
WHERE attr.attribute_name = 'Strength'
AND sp1.power_name = 'Lantern Power Ring'
AND sp2.power_name = 'Accelerated Healing'
GROUP BY p.publisher_name, a.alignment;

WITH strength_attr AS (
    SELECT id FROM attribute WHERE attribute_name = 'Strength'
),
powers_needed AS (
    SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE power_name IN ('Lantern Power Ring', 'Accelerated Healing')
),
hero_with_both AS (
    SELECT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN powers_needed pn ON hp.power_id = pn.id
    GROUP BY hp.hero_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) = 2
)
SELECT p.publisher_name,
       a.alignment,
       AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS avg_strength
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN strength_attr sa ON ha.attribute_id = sa.id
JOIN hero_with_both hw ON s.id = hw.hero_id
GROUP BY p.publisher_name,
         a.alignment;

WITH publisher_counts AS (

        COUNT(s.id) AS member_count
    FROM superhero s

),

    SELECT MAX(member_count) AS max_count
    FROM publisher_counts
)

FROM publisher_counts pc, max_members m
